datasets.name: service-performance-report
datasets.sql: select b.branch_id as "branchId", b.branch_name as "branchName", date_trunc('week', v.completed_at)::date as week, count(*) as "completedVisits", avg(v.duration_minutes)::numeric(10,1) as "averageDurationMinutes", max(v.updated_at) as "sourceUpdatedAt" from source_operations.visits v join source_operations.branches b on b.branch_id = v.branch_id where v.completed_at >= now() - (:windowDays * interval '1 day') group by b.branch_id, b.branch_name, date_trunc('week', v.completed_at)::date order by week desc, "completedVisits" desc, b.branch_id asc

refreshSchedules.name: refresh-service-performance-report
refreshSchedules.promptText: Run warm-artifact-datasets for each declared warmParams variant and refresh the private tenant-scoped precomputed JSON. Do not create a source revision, rebuild, redeploy, or modify source files.
